name: fengshui-crm-demo
description: 不帶羅盤的風水師 CRM — 開源體驗版（一鍵啟動前後端）

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "node frontend/.output/server/index.mjs"
